sourceAccountResolution.note: Pinned to the altivum-og profile on 2026-10-25. This side used to resolve through the AMBIENT default profile, which was the Altivum SOURCE when the plan was written ('The DEFAULT profile is the Altivum SOURCE', docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-28-platform-migration-qlprod.md). It no longer is: interactive shells on the founder's machine export AWS_PROFILE for an unrelated account, and an ambient resolution would make the expected source equal whatever that account is, so a --source-profile pointing at it would pass. altivum-og is the SSO route into the Altivum original account that holds the source tables. The Altivum ORG-MASTER credential (profile altivum-mgmt) is a DIFFERENT account that manages Altivum's own organization but does not itself hold the source tables ('Altivum Inc - Original Account', docs/account-migration-runbook.md) — resolving through it would check the wrong account and make this guard refuse a legitimate run. Altivum is also NOT a member of the QL Organization (verified 2026-08-28 via `aws organizations list-accounts --profile org-admin`: Delta Centric Org, Christian Perez - Personal, QL-Dev, Quantum Learner - HQ, Braket Workloads, QL-Prod; no Altivum), so an org-name lookup like the dest side's isn't an option here regardless.

destAccountResolution.note: Resolved at run time via `aws organizations list-accounts --profile org-admin --query "Accounts[?Name=='QL-Prod'].Id" --output text` (scripts/migration/README.md). No literal id is committed — this repo is public.
